title: Combined Ordinary and Extraordinary 2026 Annual General Meeting
summary: Interparfums’ shareholders are hereby informed that its combined Annual General Meeting will be held on: Friday, April 24, 2026 at 2 p.m. (Welcome of participants starting at 1 p.m.) Au Pavillon d’Armenonville, Allée de Longchamp, Bois de Boulogne – 75116 PARIS Press release
body_markdown:
Interparfums’ shareholders are hereby informed that its combined Annual General Meeting will be held on:
Friday, April 24, 2026 at 2 p.m.
(Welcome of participants starting at 1 p.m.)
Au Pavillon d’Armenonville, Allée de Longchamp,
Bois de Boulogne – 75116 PARIS


[Press release](https://media.interparfums-finance.fr/en/pdf/press-releases/CP-Convo%20AG-2026_en.pdf)
